name: polaris-knowledge-base
description: Saves collected content and summaries as Markdown files with YAML front matter (Obsidian-compatible), deduplicated by URL, with full-text search, tagging, and organizing.

interface.shortDescription: Store collected content and summaries in a searchable Markdown vault, deduplicated by URL.
interface.longDescription:
Saves collected content and summaries as Markdown files with YAML front matter (default ~/Polaris/Vault, Obsidian-compatible), deduplicated by URL, and provides kb_save / kb_list / kb_search / kb_read / kb_tag / kb_move. Writes are strictly confined to the vault directory; the kernel syncs this directory into knowledge-base retrieval. The legacy tools list_files / read_content are kept.

Security: resolved paths must stay inside the vault; POLARIS_KB_ALLOWED_DIR only constrains the legacy tools.
Requires: Python ≥3.14.
defaultPrompt: 把这篇文章存进资料库并打上 ai 标签。
在资料库里搜索关于 Agent 评估的笔记。
列出本周保存的所有摘要。
